_doc: RB12 again (rb12_w2 in run 45093828124 left behind, its later stages get no key): the rebuilt rear-wing slot follows the model's 5.7 mm, which the voxel wrap closed to 0-4 mm; the regulations of the time ask 10-15 mm between the two rear-wing sections at their closest with DRS closed, so the rebuilt slot is 12.5 mm (about 10 mm in the CFD surface). Front wing unchanged (slots 6-14 mm in the local build). mp423_w2, mp45_w3 and the 2D cases of run 45093828124 keep running.
